customManagers.description: gersemi's own python pin in .mise.toml, which the mise manager does not read. It does not update mise.lock: whoever checks the PR out runs mise lock, tools:lock-check and tools:lock-verify.

packageRules.description: CI here is advisory, not a merge gate, so every update waits for the local checks, the Codex review and a manual merge.
The CI container is a numbered Ubuntu release; dated or code-name tags such as stonking-20261105.1 are not candidates.
cmakelang (cmake-format) fails on Python 3.15, so gersemi's python stays on 3.14 patch releases.
